bodyLines: Emrahair was founded on Emrah Çabkur’s name and his hands. Today, as Echosline’s Türkiye Ambassador, he brings Italy’s colour culture to his chair in Bahçeşehir.
His specialism is Air Touch balayage and light tones: lifting without damage and putting light exactly where it belongs. The words his guests use most are care, trust and clear advice.
The team: Serdar Sezer for cuts and colour, Merve and Zeynep Aydemir for colour and blow-drys, and Gizem Değişener for nails, brows and waxing.
